paper_metadata.title: Bulk Nb3Al intermetallic compound: Synthesis and high-temperature properties

evidence.quote: Bulk Nb 3Al-based alloys were synthesized through a joint reduction of Nb2O5 and Al2O3 oxides by calcium hydride.

The Nb 3Al intermetallic compound produced by the developed technology is not inferior 
to its alloyed analogues in terms of compressive st rength (Fig. 9 (a)).

Co-reduction of calcium hydride of Nb 
2O5 and Al 2O3 oxides using a metallothermic method at 
a temperature of 1473 K produced Nb 3Al-based powder alloys.

Cast alloy with 10 at% Ta and containing about 15% vol. of Nb(Al) 
slightly exceeds the real Nb 3Al strength.
